newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Arafat to visit Netherlands on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to visit Netherlands on Monday.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will visit the Netherlands on Monday and will hold talks with Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, a Dutch government spokesman said on Thursday.
The Netherlands currently holds the presidency of the European Union.
The spokesman said he did not yet have full details of the visit or of likely topics for discussion.
He said that as far as he knew the visit would be devoted mainly to bilateral Dutch-Palestinian issues.
Arafat's visit will follow a visit to the Netherlands by Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy on Thursday.
